name: apify-scrapers
description: Public data MCP tools: Google Maps, SEC EDGAR, Glassdoor, USAspending, Twitch, Airbnb.
long_description: Six read-only tools over public data sources, each backed by a published Apify Actor. Runs execute on the caller's own Apify account and are billed to it. The server itself is standard-library Python with no third-party dependencies.

apify_token.title: Apify API token
apify_token.description: From https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Actor runs execute on your own Apify account and are billed to it.

tools.name: google_maps_search
tools.description: Extract verified commercial business listings, postal addresses, phone numbers, customer review ratings, and canonical websites from Google Maps.

tools.name: glassdoor_jobs_search
tools.description: Search active employment vacancies, hiring employers, estimated compensation bands, and corporate ratings from Glassdoor.

tools.name: sec_edgar_filings
tools.description: Retrieve official United States Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC EDGAR) regulatory filings including 10-K annual reports, 10-Q quarterly reports, and 8-K material events.

tools.name: usaspending_contracts
tools.description: Search United States federal procurement contracts, defense department awards, and prime agency obligations from the official USAspending database.

tools.name: twitch_live_streams
tools.description: Extract real-time live broadcasting streams, viewer counts, channel metadata, and game categories from Twitch.

tools.name: airbnb_listings_search
tools.description: Search vacation rental listings, nightly prices, occupancy ratings, and property classifications from Airbnb.
